_comment: Per-token RL reward sweep: token-level credit assignment for routing optimization
_rationale: Previous scalar rewards (critical_path, topn_load) failed because:
1. A single scalar reward shared across all tokens provides no credit assignment
2. Every token gets the same advantage, so REINFORCE pushes wrong tokens in wrong directions
3. Batch-to-batch data variation dominates the reward signal
This sweep tests per-token reward functions that tell each token whether
IT specifically routed to an overloaded expert:
- per_token_topn_binary: binary -1/+1 based on whether token hits a top-N loaded expert
- per_token_load_weighted: continuous reward proportional to chosen expert's load vs ideal
- critical_path: scalar baseline for comparison (the old approach)
Fixed: normalize=true, rlc=2.0, PPO+critic, discount=1.0 (layers are independent)
_fixed_rl_params: Fixed RL parameters based on previous sweep analysis
_sweep_comment: Sweep axes: reward_type x aux_loss_coeff, plus aux-only baseline

filters._comment: RL OFF baselines: only vary aux_loss_coeff, collapse all RL params
Aux-only baseline: skip the no-aux no-rl case (nothing would change)
per_token_load_weighted doesn't use topn (uses all expert loads continuously)
